notes.title: Date put back to 6 Dec
notes.text: This task showed 6 December this morning and then slid back to today. Your other device was still holding the 7 October date you set on 4 October, and a change in the board's own baseline made it look newly edited, so it won. Fixed in the code, and the date is 6 December again.

acted: Plan Locus exit: notice, LWD, handover: 07 Oct -> 06 Dec
Board: save() no longer treats a change in the baseline as an edit he made, which is what let a stale date overwrite a correction
